dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào jì zhège bāoguǒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 我刚填了一张。你看，是这张表吗？
dialogue.reading: Wǒ gāng tián le yī zhāng. Nǐ kàn, shì zhè zhāng biǎo ma?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: Duì. Kěshì nǐ děi xiān páiduì.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 没关系。刚才排队的人很多，现在少了。
dialogue.reading: Méi guānxi. Gāngcái páiduì de rén hěn duō, xiànzài shǎo le.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Wǒ yào děng duō cháng shíjiān?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 不长，等五分钟就到你了。
dialogue.reading: Bù cháng, děng wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào nǐ le.
